POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

5. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.

6. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.

7. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.

8. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

11. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.

12. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Soldering in Vehicle systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engine systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Four-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Four- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
